description: Pick a customer audience by filters (tags, last job dates, kind of work, open quotes, money owed, maintenance plans, city or postal code, has email or phone) and get the counts and a page of matching customers. Read only: it sends nothing and changes nothing. Owner or office only; money filters need see_prices.

cities.description: A service property (not archived) or a job address (job not cancelled) in one of these cities; case is ignored.

created_from.description: Customer added on or after this day (shop time zone).

has_email.description: Has an email address on the customer or on a current contact. This is not consent to marketing email; Doing Work keeps no marketing consent yet.

has_jobs.description: true: at least one job that is not cancelled. false: none.

has_open_quote.description: A quote sent and not yet signed or declined.

include_archived.description: Default false. Erased and merged customers are never included.

job_kinds.description: Has a job (not cancelled) of one of these kinds.

job_summary_contains.description: Has a job (not cancelled) whose summary contains these words, for example 'furnace'.

job_tags_any.description: Has a job (not cancelled) with one of these tags, for example the service or trade.

jobs_from.description: With job_kinds, job_tags_any or job_summary_contains: only jobs dated on or after this day count.

last_job_from.description: The customer's most recent job (not cancelled) is on or after this day, shop time zone. Customers with no jobs are left out.

last_job_to.description: The most recent job is on or before this day. Use it for customers not served since a date; pair with has_jobs:false in a second call for those never served.

max_spent_minor.description: Lifetime invoiced at most this. Needs see_prices.

min_owed_minor.description: Owes at least this much in total. Needs see_prices.

min_spent_minor.description: Lifetime invoiced (sent and later, not voided, tax included) at least this. Needs see_prices.

overdue.description: Has an invoice past its due day with money owed. Needs see_prices.

owes_money.description: Has sent invoices with money still owed. Needs see_prices.

plan_status.description: Maintenance plans. active: has an active plan. cancelled: had plans, none active now. none: never had one. any: has or had one.

plan_term_ends_from.description: Has an active maintenance plan whose current term ends on or after this day (renewals).

postal_codes.description: A service property or job address in one of these postal codes. End a code with * to match a prefix, for example 838*.

sort.description: name (default), last_job_oldest (never served first), last_job_newest or created_newest.

tags_all.description: Customers with every one of these tags.

tags_any.description: Customers with at least one of these tags.

tags_none.description: Leave out customers with any of these tags.

name: customers_audience

owed_minor.description: Total owed by those customers; null without see_prices.

owing.description: Of those, how many owe money; null without see_prices.

city.description: From the first service property, else the latest job's address.

email.description: The customer's email, or the first current contact's (primary first) when the customer has none.

owed_minor.description: Money still owed on sent invoices; null without see_prices.

phone.description: The customer's phone, or the first current contact's.

spent_minor.description: Lifetime invoiced, tax included; null without see_prices.

prices_hidden.description: true when the caller lacks see_prices, so money columns are null.
